Company Profile
**About Univers**


Univers provides the world’s most comprehensive decarbonization system. We help companies and countries optimize energy systems and reduce carbon emissions with accurate, reliable, and actionable decarbonization data. Our EnOS (Energy and Environment Operating System) platform connects on\-the\-ground operational technology and in\-the\-cloud intelligence to deliver real\-time energy data and data\-driven carbon monitoring, reporting, and abatement. With 365 million sensors and smart devices connected, 845GW of renewable energy under management, and a community of over 500 customers, we’re helping the world’s leading businesses get the world to net zero—and what comes after it. For more information, please visit https://univers.com/


Job Description
**Job Overview**


As an IoT Engineer Intern, you will work closely with the Solution Architects and the delivery team on renewable energy, microgrid and Virtual Power Plant (VPP) projects, and the pre\-sales opportunities related to them.


The successful candidate will be working with experienced personnel to handle areas including IoT application deployment, project solutioning, customer engagement and project management for renewable, microgrid and VPP related projects.

**Roles \& Responsibilities**

* Learn and execute projects from end to end — from pre\-sales solutioning, through deployment and commissioning on site, to after\-sales support
* Deploy and configure IoT applications for renewable, microgrid and VPP sites — onboarding inverters, meters, battery storage and EV chargers over industrial protocols such as Modbus, IEC 60870\-5\-104 and MQTT
* Work hands\-on with state\-of\-the\-art IoT technology from edge to cloud — edge controllers and gateways, time\-series data pipelines, and the EnOS platform
* Apply machine learning and AI optimization to generation forecasting, energy dispatch and VPP control strategies
* Support the presales team in their sales pursuits
* Design technical solutions including architectures and technical proposals with the necessary hardware and software to ensure customers’ requirements are met
* Carry out project planning activities through cost estimation and risk mitigation
* Develop the business models of new energy through business analysis of potential opportunities from both technical and commercial perspectives

**Desired Skills and Experience**

* Currently pursuing a Bachelor/Master Degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or related field.
* Knowledge and experience in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning are strongly preferred.
* Good understanding or experience with software, renewable energy, and the power industry.

jobs.title: Senior Test Engineer II, Manufacturing Engineering
jobs.description:
Singapore
  
**Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture.**


For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.


**Job's mission**



As a Senior Test Engineer, you’ll play a critical role in turning breakthrough designs into real\-world manufacturing solutions. From concept to customer delivery, you’ll drive new product industrialization by working cross\-functionally to optimize for quality, cost, and lead time. You’ll be a strategic partner to both Global Operations and our Business Units, influencing design, improving processes, and supporting the full product lifecycle.

  


**What you will be working on**


* Design and develop cost\-effective testing methods with innovations on automation for systems and equipment testing throughout product development and manufacturing in meeting efficiency and customer quality requirements.
* Provide holistic technical solutions and drive standardization of testing methodology to produce consistent testing quality outcome in addressing testing needs across supplier, contract manufacturing, and internal manufacturing by liaising with cross functional teams in GOPS and Business Units (BU).
* Prepare test and diagnostic programs according to product requirements, refine detailed test specifications, develop detailed procedures, including assisting with the definition of test specifications with design / software engineering.
* Develop hardware and software for test fixtures, plan and coordinate test fixture sourcing activities as needed, debug and deploy test fixtures for production.
* Gathers operational and test data to evaluate test results; may take corrective/continuous improvement actions.
* Work with internal and external stakeholders to influence decisions and drive product testing improvements.

  


**What we are looking for**


* Bachelor’s degree in electrical/electronic engineering, automation engineering or equivalent.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment, ideally 5 years in semiconductor capital equipment industry.
* Experience in testing optimization, including test case/option addition, automation and standardization initiatives
* Experience with control systems utilized in testing automation, serial communication protocols, TwinCAT PLC, DeviceNet, EtherCAT, RS 485, RS 232, etc.
* Working knowledge of testing methodology as well as programming languages such as C\#, Python, etc.
* Proven track record of managing technical projects to completion while accomplishing objectives and influencing cross\-functional teams
* Proficient in operational excellence tools such as FMEA, 8D, SPC and Six Sigma

  


**What sets you apart**


* Strong cross\-functional communication, stakeholder engagement, presentation and organization skills
* Experience in test automation for equipment product and IoT devices integration
* Exposure to manufacturing digitization and data\-driven process improvement

**Apply today to be part of what’s next.**



We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting\-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.



To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.



*ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, UI (FICCO)
jobs.description:
**DRW** is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.



Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non\-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.



We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it's not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. **DRW** is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.



DRW is looking for an outstanding Senior Software Engineer to join our options trading desk. In this role, you will focus on designing, building, and implementing trading applications and tools. You will be an integral member of an algorithmic trading team comprising experienced technologists, quantitative researchers, and traders. Your team will work closely to solve challenging technological problems. We are looking for talented programmers eager to develop new technologies that directly impact our business.


**Responsibilities:**


* Design, build, test, and maintain data\-intensive desktop applications and reusable libraries using C\# and modern .NET
* Develop and maintain systems to ensure application performance, integrity and reliability for maintaining maximal up\-time, and logging and traceability to aid in the support of mission\-critical production systems
* Profile and improve rendering, memory usage, concurrency, reactive data pipelines, and application startup performance
* Collaborate with quantitative researchers, traders, and other developers
* Own software through its full lifecycle, including design, implementation, automated testing, instrumentation, deployment, staged rollout, and production support
* Leverage AI\-assisted and agentic development tools to accelerate delivery, improve software quality, and evolve the team's engineering practices.


**Requirements:**


* Bachelor's in Computer Science or related discipline or relevant work experience.
* 5\+ years of professional software development experience, with substantial experience building C\#/.NET desktop applications
* A thorough understanding of C\# UI development and tooling
* Should be comfortable in a fast\-paced environment that continually embraces the latest technologies and techniques.
* Effective communication skills, ability to read and write high and mid\-level architecture documentation
* Awareness of emerging technologies/standards

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?
At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life\-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.
Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.
Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (Sequencing Instrument Platform)  



  

**Position Summary**

The Senior Mechanical Design Engineer in Illumina’s R\&D department will lead and contribute to the development of new, industry\-leading genetic analysis platforms for life sciences and clinical markets. The engineer will be responsible for design of DNA sequencing equipment that includes complex optical, mechanical, electrical, chemical, and software sub\-systems. The engineer will be responsible for participating in and coordinating cross\-functional teams, developing plans, performing analysis, and innovating new technologies.  



  

**Job duties and responsibilities include:**

* Uncover product requirements and translate requirements into subsystem specifications.
* Design precision electro\-mechanical and fluidic mechanisms.
* Work in concurrent, cross\-functional teams.
* Actively seek out and collect input from stakeholders across supporting disciplines.
* Manage outsourced design and manufacturing relationships.
* Compare performance and cost of design options in a data driven manner.
* Perform mechanical and thermal analysis of subsystem / system designs.
* Create schedules and manage actions to meet milestones.
* Perform risk analysis, develop test plans, and execute verification testing of subsystems and systems.
* Follow through on transfer of new products into manufacturing, track issues in manufacturing and the field, and implement resolution of issues.
* Propose and investigate new architecture, technologies and products that enable the goals of Illumina’s product portfolio.
* Candidates must thrive in a dynamic environment and place great emphasis on meeting milestones and breaking down barriers to achieve results.
* Candidate would be required to travel to US for work purposes

All listed tasks and responsibilities are deemed as essential functions to this position; however, business conditions may require reasonable accommodation for additional tasks and responsibilities.  



  

**Preferred:**

* Experience in biomedical instruments, biological assays, and/or genetic analysis equipment is preferred.
Experience in FDA regulated markets is a plus.  
* 

  

**Education and experience:**

* BS/MS/PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or related and \>5 years industry experience.
* Candidate must have experience in product development, transfer to manufacturing, and documentation.
* Candidate must have a proven track record in designing robust electro\-mechanical systems which may include imaging, dynamic motion control, fluidics components, and thermal control.
* Demonstrated knowledge of mechanical engineering design principles and practices \- Form, fit, tolerance stack analysis, GD\&T, drafting standards, FEA, design for assembly, design for manufacturing, etc.
* Experience with a wide variety of manufacturing processes (low, medium, and high volume).
* Selection of electromechanical components such as motors, power transmission components and sensors.
* Evaluation and optimization of complex tolerance budgets.
* Candidate must have strong project management skills and interpersonal, relationship\-building skills.
* Fluent in SolidWorks CAD software and one or more mechanical FEA packages.

All listed requirements are deemed essential functions to this position; however, business conditions may require reasonable accommodation for additional tasks and responsibilities.  



  

**ATTITUDE/ATTRIBUTES:**

* Ability and willingness to make an impact
* Creativity of thought and mindset
* Thrives in a dynamic and fast paced environment
A passion for discovery  
*

We are proud to confirm a zero\-net gap in pay, regardless of gender, ethnicity, or race. jobs.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?
At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life\-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.
Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.
Staff Mechanical Design Engineer (Sequencing Instrument Platform)  



  

**Position Summary**

The Staff Mechanical Design Engineer in Illumina’s R\&D department will lead and contribute to the development of new, industry\-leading genetic analysis platforms for life sciences and clinical markets. The engineer will be responsible for design of DNA sequencing equipment that includes complex optical, mechanical, electrical, chemical, and software sub\-systems. The engineer will be responsible for participating in and coordinating cross\-functional teams, developing plans, performing analysis, and innovating new technologies.  



  

**Job duties and responsibilities include:**

* Uncover product requirements and translate requirements into subsystem specifications.
* Design precision electro\-mechanical and fluidic mechanisms.
* Work in concurrent, cross\-functional teams.
* Actively seek out and collect input from stakeholders across supporting disciplines.
* Manage outsourced design and manufacturing relationships.
* Compare performance and cost of design options in a data driven manner.
* Perform mechanical and thermal analysis of subsystem / system designs.
* Create schedules and manage actions to meet milestones.
* Perform risk analysis, develop test plans, and execute verification testing of subsystems and systems.
* Follow through on transfer of new products into manufacturing, track issues in manufacturing and the field, and implement resolution of issues.
* Propose and investigate new architecture, technologies and products that enable the goals of Illumina’s product portfolio.
* Candidates must thrive in a dynamic environment and place great emphasis on meeting milestones and breaking down barriers to achieve results.
* Candidate would be required to travel to US for work purposes

All listed tasks and responsibilities are deemed as essential functions to this position; however, business conditions may require reasonable accommodation for additional tasks and responsibilities.  



  

**Preferred:**

* Experience in biomedical instruments, biological assays, and/or genetic analysis equipment is preferred.
Experience in FDA regulated markets is a plus.  
* 

  

**Education and experience:**

* BS/MS/PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or related and \>8 years industry experience.
* Candidate must have experience in product development, transfer to manufacturing, and documentation.
* Candidate must have a proven track record in designing robust electro\-mechanical systems which may include imaging, dynamic motion control, fluidics components, and thermal control.
* Demonstrated knowledge of mechanical engineering design principles and practices \- Form, fit, tolerance stack analysis, GD\&T, drafting standards, FEA, design for assembly, design for manufacturing, etc.
* Experience with a wide variety of manufacturing processes (low, medium, and high volume).
* Selection of electromechanical components such as motors, power transmission components and sensors.
* Evaluation and optimization of complex tolerance budgets.
* Candidate must have strong project management skills and interpersonal, relationship\-building skills.
* Fluent in SolidWorks CAD software and one or more mechanical FEA packages.

All listed requirements are deemed essential functions to this position; however, business conditions may require reasonable accommodation for additional tasks and responsibilities.  



  

**ATTITUDE/ATTRIBUTES:**

* Ability and willingness to make an impact
* Creativity of thought and mindset
* Thrives in a dynamic and fast paced environment
A passion for discovery  
* 

  

We are a company deeply rooted in belonging, promoting an inclusive environment where employees feel valued and empowered to contribute to our mission. Built on a strong foundation, Illumina has always prioritized openness, collaboration, and seeking alternative perspectives to propel innovation in genomics. We are proud to confirm a zero\-net gap in pay, regardless of gender, ethnicity, or race. We also have several Employee Resource Groups (ERG) that deliver career development experiences, increase cultural awareness, and offer opportunities to engage in social responsibility. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status, and genetic information. Illumina conducts background checks on applicants for whom a conditional offer of employment has been made. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws. Background check results may potentially result in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment. The background check process and any decisions made as a result shall be made in accordance with all applicable local, state, and federal laws. Illumina prohibits the use of generative artificial intelligence (AI) in the application and interview process. If you require accommodation to complete the application or interview process, please contact accommodations@illumina.com. To learn more, visit: https://www.dol.gov/ofccp/regs/compliance/posters/pdf/eeopost.pdf. The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected or the requisition has a sufficient number of qualified applicants. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

jobs.title: Technical Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
**The Role**
------------



The Technical Operations Engineer is responsible for maintaining operational excellence across systems, processes, and technology platforms. This role focuses on incident management, operational monitoring, process optimization, stakeholder support, and continuous improvement to ensure reliable business and customer operations.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------



Operations Management

* Be on rotation for availability incidents and provide support for customer service engineers.
* Proactively develop scripts and tools to prevent incidents from ever happening.
* Monitor and maintain daily operational performance of systems and services.
* Ensure timely resolution of operational issues and service disruptions.
* Manage operational workflows and process adherence.

  

Incident \& Escalation Management

* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams during incidents and escalations.
* Conduct root cause analysis and implement preventive actions.

  

Process Improvement

* Identify inefficiencies and recommend automation opportunities.
* Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Drive operational excellence initiatives and continuous improvement projects.

  

Data Analysis \& Reporting

* Monitor and report on operational KPIs and service metrics.
* Analyze trends, risks, and performance gaps.
* Prepare dashboards and management reports.

  

Stakeholder Collaboration

* Partner with Engineering, Product, Customer Support, and Business Operations teams.
* Provide operational guidance and technical support to stakeholders.
* Communicate status updates and recommendations effectively.

  

Compliance \& Risk Management

* Ensure compliance with operational policies and security standards.
* Identify operational risks and develop mitigation plans.
* Support audit and governance activities as required.
**Requirements**
----------------


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in Technical Operations, IT Operations, System Support, Data Operations, or a related role.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Experience with ticketing systems and monitoring tools.
* Proficiency in SQL, Excel, or data analysis tools.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong programming skills, Net, Java, Python, JavaScript, etc.
* Strong experience with Monitoring tools: Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Cloudwatch, ELK, etc.
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
* Knowledge of scripting or automation tools (Python, PowerShell, Shell Scripting).
* Familiarity with ITIL, Agile, or DevOps methodologies.
* Experience supporting large\-scale production environments.

jobs.title: Senior Test Engineer II, Manufacturing Engineering
jobs.description:
**Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture.**


For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what's next, at the forefront of innovation and what's technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we're more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.


**Job's mission**



As a Senior Test Engineer, you'll play a critical role in turning breakthrough designs into real\-world manufacturing solutions. From concept to customer delivery, you'll drive new product industrialization by working cross\-functionally to optimize for quality, cost, and lead time. You'll be a strategic partner to both Global Operations and our Business Units, influencing design, improving processes, and supporting the full product lifecycle.

  


**What you will be working on**


* Design and develop cost\-effective testing methods with innovations on automation for systems and equipment testing throughout product development and manufacturing in meeting efficiency and customer quality requirements.
* Provide holistic technical solutions and drive standardization of testing methodology to produce consistent testing quality outcome in addressing testing needs across supplier, contract manufacturing, and internal manufacturing by liaising with cross functional teams in GOPS and Business Units (BU).
* Prepare test and diagnostic programs according to product requirements, refine detailed test specifications, develop detailed procedures, including assisting with the definition of test specifications with design / software engineering.
* Develop hardware and software for test fixtures, plan and coordinate test fixture sourcing activities as needed, debug and deploy test fixtures for production.
* Gathers operational and test data to evaluate test results; may take corrective/continuous improvement actions.
* Work with internal and external stakeholders to influence decisions and drive product testing improvements.

  


**What we are looking for**


* Bachelor's degree in electrical/electronic engineering, automation engineering or equivalent.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment, ideally 5 years in semiconductor capital equipment industry.
* Experience in testing optimization, including test case/option addition, automation and standardization initiatives
* Experience with control systems utilized in testing automation, serial communication protocols, TwinCAT PLC, DeviceNet, EtherCAT, RS 485, RS 232, etc.
* Working knowledge of testing methodology as well as programming languages such as C\#, Python, etc.
* Proven track record of managing technical projects to completion while accomplishing objectives and influencing cross\-functional teams
* Proficient in operational excellence tools such as FMEA, 8D, SPC and Six Sigma

  


**What sets you apart**


* Strong cross\-functional communication, stakeholder engagement, presentation and organization skills
* Experience in test automation for equipment product and IoT devices integration
* Exposure to manufacturing digitization and data\-driven process improvement

**Apply today to be part of what's next.**



We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what's possible through cutting\-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.



To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.



*ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

jobs.title: Engineer, IT
jobs.description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.**


Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.

**Responsibilities**

* You will involve in the application lifecycle management for software systems in a highly automated semiconductor manufacturing environment
* Develop a keen understanding of IT and Manufacturing Automation trends and apply the knowledge to participate in technical and business analysis sessions to understand requirements.
* Collaborate with global IT team from divest backgrounds and experiences to convert those requirements into effective and efficient technical solutions.
* Serve as IT technical authority within Micron, provide advice and recommendations to senior management on improvements from processes, procedures and software system development.
* Ensure Secure Software Development Lifecycle standard, requiring adherence to security best practices during development, deployment and maintenance; includes risk assessment, secure coding standard and guidelines, and compliance with internal governance framework.
* Ensure a good quality software releases with detail software acceptance testing, verification and end\-users training.
* Keep applications software and hardware systems to the most current production releases version by applying update and patches as required.
* Develop capabilities to prevent unscheduled downtime with systems monitoring to identify and fix abnormalities actively.
* Leveraging AI\-powered development, automation and analytic tools to improve software delivery, code quality, and operational efficiency.
* Continuously develop AI proficiency and adopt emerging technologies to accelerate innovation and business value creation.

**Job Requirements**

* Minimum Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical \& Electronics/Computer/Software Engineering and Information Systems or equivalent.
* Proficiency in programming language such as C\#/C\+\+, Perl, .NET Core, Angular, SQL, or similar.
* Creative and have passion in implementing innovative IT solutions to resolve important business problems.
* Good interpersonal and communication skills. Bring in your enthusiasm as you will work with a dynamic team to achieve a common goal through effective collaboration and dedication.
* Highly adaptable to our fast paced, dynamic and rapidly changing work environment; Response and solve high priority Manufacturing Software Applications problems, as required.
* We are looking for a highly motivated team member with good software project management skill and having an exposure to agile development methodology will be advantageous
* Embody **Micron’s core values:**

**People –** Respect, develop, and empower others

**Innovation –** Drive continuous improvement and breakthrough thinking

**Tenacity –** Show grit and determination

**Collaboration –** Build trust and foster teamwork

**Customer Focus –** Deliver excellence and value

**About Micron Technology, Inc.**


We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life *for all*. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high\-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.  

  

To learn more, please visit micron.com/careers  

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.  

  

To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact hrsupport\_sg@micron.com
